newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gottardo says Q1 business very good.
newsitem.headline: Gottardo says Q1 business very good.

text.p: Banca del Gottardo, majority-owned by Japan's Sumitomo Bank said business in the quarter of 1997 had been "very very good."

However, Gottardo chairman Claudio Generali declined to give a forecast for the current year at a news conference, referring to uncertainty surrounding interest rates and continued uncertainties in the property sector.
Gottardo's 1996 group net profit rose to 55.4 million Swiss francs from 53.8 million, slightly higher than the 53 million the bank estimated for 1996 profit in January.
Gross profit in 1996 rose to 160.81 million francs from 147.37 million.
Provisions for credit risks was increased by 65 percent to 144.39 million francs and the bank took a depreciation charge of 16.3 million on its assets.
